title: Converted files and query results
description: One dataset item per input: its Parquet link and schema report, the query rows when sql was given, or the error (code, message, hint) when the input failed. The Parquet files are in the run's key-value store under keys starting with parquet-.

results.title: Results
results.description: One item per input, in input order: status (converted, failed or skipped), parquetUrl, rows, columns, report, query or queryError, error, and the events charged for it.

parquetFiles.title: Parquet files
parquetFiles.description: The converted Parquet files, one record per converted input (key parquet-NNN-<name>.parquet).
